This role requires a seasoned operational leader capable of driving consistency, safety, and execution across a diverse project portfolio. Position Overview The Vice President of Operations is the senior executive responsible for driving performance, efficiency, and execution across operations. This leader oversees the full lifecycle of construction delivery, from preconstruction through closeout, while ensuring operational excellence, financial discipline, and consistent execution across a diverse portfolio of construction projects, including international airports, complex infrastructure, education campuses, hospitals, and joint ventures. This role requires a seasoned operator with deep experience managing multifaceted, large-scale construction programs, leading high-performing teams, strengthening client relationships, and supporting business growth. The VP of Operations will serve as a strategic partner to executive leadership, supporting a culture of accountability and urgency that drives long-term growth, quality, and profitability. Key Responsibilities Oversee all business operations, including preconstruction, estimating, project management, field operations, safety, quality, scheduling, project controls, and resource allocation. Establish operational strategy aligned with organizational goals, market conditions, and client expectations. Lead crisis response and high-risk situations with clarity, decisiveness, and professionalism. Partner with Corporate Finance and Accounting to achieve company financial goals. Accountable for P&L performance, including margins, cost control, financial accuracy, budgeting, forecasting, and cost-of-sales management. Implement operational policies, performance standards, and best practices with internal teams to ensure consistency and drive continuous improvement across all projects. Review and approve major budget adjustments, operational changes, and strategic recommendations. Prepare and present concise weekly operational updates to the CEO and senior leadership. Report on project status, financial performance, backlog and pipeline activity, safety and quality metrics, key risks, staffing needs, decisions required, and corrective-action plans. Communicate clearly and effectively with executive leadership, project teams, clients, and external stakeholders in writing, meetings, and presentations. Strengthen long-term relationships with senior executive partners, owners, developers, design and joint-venture partners, and other key stakeholders through consistent delivery, communication, documentation, and responsiveness. Support and actively participate in business-development efforts by providing operational expertise during strategic pursuits, interviews, and proposal development. Partner with executive leadership to help identify and pursue opportunities that strengthen the company’s pipeline and support profitable growth. Represent the organization within the construction industry and regional market. Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing operational leaders, project managers, project support staff, and field teams. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and a high sense of urgency. Support succession planning and lead performance-management processes, including goal setting, coaching, and annual reviews. Work alongside and support the Director of Safety and safety department. Champion a strong safety culture, with emphasis on high-risk activity and local team ownership of results. Ensure compliance with all regulatory, accreditation, and contractual requirements. Oversee quality assurance/quality-control programs and drive improvement in safety and quality metrics. Integrate operations, engineering, technology, and customer service to create streamlined, cost-effective business processes. Apply knowledge of modern construction technologies, including VDC, BIM, Lean planning, scheduling systems, and enterprise resource platforms. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Business, or related field preferred. Minimum 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in commercial construction, including oversight of large, complex infrastructure, airport, or other mission-critical projects. Proven ability to manage multiple large-scale projects and competing priorities simultaneously. Demonstrated success leading operations for a general contractor or construction management firm. Strong financial acumen, including P&L management, forecasting, and margin performance. Exceptional leadership, executive communication, and relationship-building skills. Experience working in regulated, high-risk environments such as aviation, healthcare, or industrial facilities. Preferred Qualifications Professional certifications: CCM, PMP, PE, DBIA, LEED AP, OSHA 30, and/or First Aid/AED. Active membership in professional organizations: CMAA, PMI, DBIA, AIA, and/or ASCE. Background in design-build, negotiated work, or integrated project delivery.

review_candidates.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Senior Technical Project Manager – Thermal Generation Project Development and New Technologies, AMEA ENGIE group is a global reference in low-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers. ENGIE’s Business Unit for the Asia Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is headquartered in Dubai. The region has activities in large scale power generation, water desalination, district cooling, energy solutions and renewables including green hydrogen, wind and solar. We act throughout the value chain: strategy, design, engineering, energy-efficient asset construction, digital platforms, operations management, financing syndication and outcome assurance. And, by using globally leading technologies, we create innovative energy and smart solutions that help to make the world a better place.. Objective The Senior Technical Project Manager (STPM) - Thermal Generation Projects and New Technologies leads the technical development of large power projects and supports the decarbonization initiatives of the thermal generation fleet in Asia, Middle East and Africa region (AMEA). The STPM will be responsible for supporting the extensions of PPAs of existing thermal assets, development of greenfield thermal power projects (OCGT and CCGT), asset decarbonization initiatives and projects, assessment of new technologies in collaboration with the ENGIE Group Research and Innovation ecosystem, and management of third party engineering consultants. S/he may from time to time also be involved in Hydrogen and Battery Energy Storage projects. Reporting line The STPM reports to the Head of Engineering and Technical Support, Generation International MENA. Job responsibility Technical Project Management (Thermal Generation Greenfield Projects and Extensions) Provides the technical definition of the project and manages the selection of technologies, specifications, configuration, performance analysis, availability, outages, and evaluation of innovative technology solutions. Assure safety operability and maintainability is careful considered in new plant designs. Manages/Reviews all project related studies during bidding/development phase till hand-over to execution: pre-feasibility studies (if any), feasibility studies (if any), ESIA studies… Leads the technical development and documentation of the contractual agreements during development/bidding and negotiation stage: EPC, PPA, electricity connection agreement, LTPRA, LTSA, O&M Contracts etc... Contributes to the technical qualification of EPC Contractors Manages the main equipment supplier’s selection with the EPC contractor. Animates and manages several technical review meetings with the EPC contractor to optimize the plant design. Manages the technical mark up and proposed deviations (if any) of bidding documents. In narrow coordination with Procurement proposes and defines technical-commercial optimizations with the contractor(s). In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares the technical related part of the project execution and operation. In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares all Construction technical and O&M related documents for the proposal/bid: EPC Term sheet and/or EPC Contract, O&M Term Sheet and/or contract, OM organization chart, including Guarantees and testing procedures, O&M philosophy... Based on technical assumptions develop the CAPEX and OPEX cost for the project. Liaises with the lenders and the Lender's Engineer for the establishment of their due diligence report prior to Financial Close. Ensures detail coordination with all internal stakeholders: BD, Construction, Operation, Legal, Finance and Procurement teams Contributes to the internal approval process (for Bid submission including Construction, Technical and O&M) until Financial Close. Ensures adequate internal reviews. Support the negotiations with the contractors. Punctually provides support to construction and operation activities. Prepares the technical hand-over for execution stage. Ensures experience capitalization and REX integration. New Technologies and Decarbonisation Lead Acts as a SPOC for the ENGIE Group Research & Innovation (R&I) programmes and community Leads on implementation of decarbonisation initiatives or projects and supports other team members with decarbonisation topics Maintains a technology watch Fosters the innovation culture by coordinating and animating knowledge sharing Lead on Engagement of Third-Party Engineering Consultants Keeps a market watch on engineering consultants (technical advisors) Leads the qualification, tendering, selection and management of technical consultants: Bid Technical Advisor, Owners’ Engineer, Lenders’ Technical Advisors, ESIA Consultant… on various AMEA projects Qualification/Experience Engineering degree, with a minimum of 15 years of experience. Experience in projects technical development. Experience in bid preparation. Experience in thermal power generation projects (preferably CCGT). Excellent capability in interpreting and optimising power plant design and performance; experience using Thermoflow software is a plus. Good understanding of thermal generation decarbonisation technologies, including renewable gases, CCUS… Experience in engaging and working with engineering consulting firms. Experience in preparing and negotiating contractual documents: WPA, PPA, PWPA, EPC, EPCM, subcontractors, O&M, LTSA, LTPRA, consultants’ contracts... Experienced in interfacing with BD team, legal team, finance team, construction team, operation team. Experience in managing and coordinating research and innovation programmes will be an advantage. Experience in desalination will be an advantage. Experience within ENGIE Group will be an advantage. Character And Skills Pro-active, autonomous, taking ownership of issues and drive to resolve them Organized and rigorous Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills Able to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders from different backgrounds Languages: fluent English. Arab or French will be an advantage. Location Dubai HQ. review_candidates.title: Senior Project Manager
review_candidates.description: The opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as a Senior Project Manager and be an expert. This role allows you to gain in-depth knowledge of the market and provide our clients with the best-in-class product. You'll play a crucial role in making a significant impact on our business growth and customer satisfaction and contribute to building a team/function. This is your chance to work in a global environment where your expertise and creativity will be highly valued. How You’ll Make An Impact You will lead the project team allocated to the project, defining main guidelines, allocating project tasks, and motivating and monitoring internal and external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones. You will be responsible for providing performance feedback regarding allocated resources working on projects. Defining, jointly with the Project Controls department, all project plan documents, including scope and financial plans, schedule, and risk management plans. You will ensure that the project follows execution best practices and Hitachi Energy policies. Effectively monitors and controls project progress and efficient resource utilization. You will monitor and control project financials, overseeing project invoicing status, cost, expenses, and cash flow. Identifies, qualifies, quantifies, and manages project risks, and ensures that all opportunities are identified and pursued. Captures, analyses, and shares lessons learned throughout the project. Ensure that the project is formally closed out, as contractually agreed. Drives the formal acceptance of the project, contract close-out, and its acknowledgment by the customer. You will ensure that the project consistently applies to contract and claims management, by Hitachi Energy policies and contractual agreements. You will coordinate with supply chain management, and successfully procure the required services, materials, and equipment for the project from external and internal suppliers. You will support supply chain management in supplier negotiations, claims, and project changes. Completes risk and opportunity assessments and ensures implementation of resulting actions in one's area of responsibility. Ensure any contract/quality/program/cost issues are under control management and solution. Acts as key contact for the customer and an escalation point for project issues. You will build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. Ensures the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies. You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background You hold a bachelor's degree or above, in power engineering field is a plus. At least 5 years of Electrical Power Engineering industry experience required. Experience in leading substation project of project management. Clear thinking and acting systematically for customer handling. Aggressive to learn and strong leadership engagement concept Domestic travel frequency. Fluent English in project management of listening, speaking, reading & writing. More About Us At Hitachi Energy, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where you can grow and develop. We value safety and integrity, taking responsibility for our actions while caring for our colleagues and the business. Join us and be part of a team that is powering good for a sustainable energy future. If you have any inquiries about our job openings in Taiwan, please feel free to email us at elly.hsu@hitachienergy.com. Publication date : 2025-07-04

review_candidates.title: Senior Investment Associate
review_candidates.description: We're Hiring: Senior Investment Associate Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Experience Level: Senior Work Arrangement: Fully Remote About Us We are a globally focused organization committed to identifying, evaluating, and managing investment opportunities across diverse markets and asset classes. Our teams combine investment, finance, strategy, research, risk, legal, tax, and commercial expertise to support disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation. Our investment function applies rigorous financial analysis, market research, valuation, due diligence, portfolio monitoring, and risk assessment to evaluate opportunities and provide clear recommendations to investment committees and senior leadership. The Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Investment Associate to support investment origination, financial analysis, valuation, due diligence, transaction execution, portfolio monitoring, and investment reporting. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical and financial-modeling capabilities with commercial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail. The role will work closely with investment professionals, management teams, advisors, lenders, legal counsel, and other stakeholders throughout the investment lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Support the identification, screening, and evaluation of potential investment opportunities. Conduct detailed analysis of investment opportunities across relevant sectors, markets, and asset classes. Perform company, industry, market, and competitive analysis to assess investment attractiveness. Review business models, revenue drivers, cost structures, competitive positioning, and growth strategies. Analyze historical and projected financial statements and operating performance. Build and maintain detailed financial models for investment analysis and valuation. Develop operating models, three-statement models, cash-flow models, and scenario analyses. Perform valuation using appropriate methodologies, including discounted cash flow, comparable companies, precedent transactions, and other relevant approaches. Analyze investment returns, including IRR, MOIC, NPV, payback, and other applicable return metrics. Conduct sensitivity and downside-case analysis to assess investment resilience. Evaluate key assumptions underlying management forecasts and business plans. Identify material investment risks, value drivers, opportunities, and potential downside scenarios. Prepare investment screening materials, investment memoranda, financial analyses, and recommendation papers. Support investment committee materials and presentations. Present financial analysis, valuation conclusions, risks, and recommendations to senior investment professionals. Conduct market and industry research using financial databases, public filings, research reports, and other credible sources. Monitor macroeconomic, regulatory, technological, and market developments relevant to investment decisions. Track transaction pipelines and maintain accurate records of potential and active investment opportunities. Coordinate due-diligence activities across financial, commercial, operational, legal, tax, technical, ESG, and other workstreams. Prepare due-diligence request lists and coordinate information requirements with target companies and advisors. Review financial, commercial, operational, and legal due-diligence findings. Identify discrepancies between management information, financial records, and third-party diligence findings. Assess quality of earnings, working capital, debt, cash flow, capital expenditure, and other key financial considerations where applicable. Analyze customer concentration, supplier exposure, recurring revenue, contract structures, and other commercial drivers. Evaluate management plans, growth assumptions, capital requirements, and operational strategies. Support negotiation analysis by assessing transaction economics and valuation implications. Assist with transaction structuring and analysis of potential financing arrangements. Evaluate capital structures, debt capacity, leverage, and financing costs where relevant. Coordinate with external advisors, investment banks, consultants, lawyers, accountants, and other transaction professionals. Track transaction milestones, deliverables, approvals, and execution risks. Support preparation of transaction documentation and closing materials. Maintain comprehensive investment files, models, diligence records, approvals, and decision documentation. Ensure investment analysis and recommendations are supported by reliable data and clearly documented assumptions. Monitor portfolio investments following transaction completion. Analyze portfolio-company financial performance against budgets, business plans, forecasts, and investment cases. Track revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, leverage, liquidity, capital expenditure, and other portfolio KPIs. Prepare recurring portfolio monitoring reports and investment performance updates. Identify emerging portfolio risks, operational challenges, underperformance, and value-creation opportunities. Support portfolio companies with financial analysis, strategic planning, performance improvement, and value-creation initiatives where appropriate. Evaluate follow-on investment opportunities, refinancing requirements, capital raises, exits, and other portfolio transactions. Conduct exit analysis and assess potential valuation and return outcomes. Support preparation of exit, refinancing, recapitalization, or divestment materials. Monitor investment performance against approved investment theses and return objectives. Maintain accurate investment performance data and portfolio dashboards. Support periodic valuation processes and review valuation assumptions. Assist with financial reporting and investment performance analysis for internal stakeholders and investors where applicable. Monitor compliance with investment mandates, approval conditions, portfolio limits, and governance requirements. Support investment-risk monitoring and escalation of material concerns. Maintain awareness of conflicts of interest, confidentiality, information barriers, and applicable compliance requirements. Conduct research on new investment themes, emerging sectors, technologies, and business models. Identify potential opportunities arising from market dislocations, structural trends, and changing industry dynamics. Develop investment theses supported by market evidence, financial analysis, and risk assessment. Benchmark portfolio companies and potential investments against relevant industry and market comparables. Key Performance Indicators Investment opportunity screening completion Investment pipeline quality Investment pipeline conversion Investment analysis turnaround time Financial model accuracy Valuation accuracy Investment memorandum quality Investment committee material quality Due-diligence completion Due-diligence issue identification Investment thesis quality Investment risk identification Downside-case analysis completion Sensitivity-analysis quality Investment return analysis accuracy IRR analysis accuracy MOIC analysis accuracy Transaction execution timeliness Transaction budget adherence Transaction milestone completion Portfolio reporting timeliness Portfolio reporting accuracy Portfolio performance monitoring Portfolio KPI coverage Portfolio risk identification Portfolio risk-mitigation completion Investment thesis tracking Value-creation initiative completion Revenue-growth support EBITDA improvement support Cash-flow improvement Portfolio valuation accuracy Exit-analysis quality Follow-on investment analysis Capital-allocation support Investment committee decision-support effectiveness Market and sector research quality Investment opportunity identification Research-to-investment insight conversion Data quality and integrity Investment governance compliance Investment-policy compliance Documentation completeness External advisor management Stakeholder satisfaction Analytical process improvement Investment technology adoption Junior-team development Ideal Candidate The successful candidate should have strong experience in investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking, corporate finance, asset management, transaction advisory, or another investment-focused environment , preferably with exposure to complex transactions, financial modeling, and portfolio analysis. The candidate should demonstrate: Proven experience evaluating investment opportunities and preparing investment analysis. Strong financial-modeling and valuation capabilities. Advanced understanding of financial statements and business performance. Experience performing discounted cash flow and comparable-company analysis. Strong understanding of investment return metrics and transaction economics. Experience conducting commercial, financial, and market research. Strong ability to assess business models, competitive positioning, and growth opportunities. Experience developing investment theses and recommendation materials. Strong understanding of transaction due diligence and deal execution processes. Experience coordinating with investment banks, advisors, consultants, lawyers, and target companies. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities. Experience performing sensitivity analysis, scenario modeling, and downside assessment.

review_candidates.title: Regional Site Execution Excellence Manager
review_candidates.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You are regularly on the ground, moving from site to site across the region to support project teams during critical execution phases. As a trusted on‑site advisor, you work closely with project managers, site managers, site supervisors, and contractors to strengthen execution quality, safety, and discipline. You observe site setups and daily operations, identify execution risks and deviations early, and provide hands‑on guidance to improve performance. Drawing on best practices from across the region and global standards, you help teams resolve issues pragmatically, stabilize challenging situations, and prevent recurrence. Where required, you escalate critical risks and systemic issues through established governance channels. Your role is not to manage projects, but to enable successful execution by strengthening site management capability, contractor performance, and compliance with EHS and quality standards across Grid Solutions projects in Asia Pacific & China. How You’ll Make An Impact Provide on‑site advisory support to project and site teams during project execution, with a focus on civil works, electrical installation, site supervision, and operational site management. Coach site managers and supervisors on best practices in site organization, planning, contractor coordination, progress tracking, and issue resolution. Support project teams in assessing and improving contractor performance, including productivity, workmanship quality, and compliance with contractual and technical requirements. Support tender teams in optimizing bids to gain competitiveness in the market Act as a troubleshooter on site, helping to analyze execution challenges and implement practical corrective measures in collaboration with project teams. Reinforce and promote EHS excellence, identifying unsafe practices, behavioral risks, and systemic gaps, and supporting implementation of preventive and corrective actions. Support quality management on site, including workmanship quality, inspection readiness, documentation discipline, and compliance with QM standards. Identify recurring execution issues and feed structured lessons learned and best practices back to the regional PMO and governance organization. Act as an early‑warning mechanism, escalating critical execution, safety, or quality risks through defined regional governance channels when required. Support the implementation of global and regional project execution initiatives, standards, and tools at site level. Serve as a trusted sparring partner for project managers and site leadership, strengthening execution maturity without replacing line responsibility. What You Bring Several years of hands‑on experience in site execution and site management for energy, infrastructure, or EPC/turnkey projects (substations, grid solutions, or comparable environments preferred). Strong practical understanding of civil works and electrical installation activities on complex construction sites. Strong knowledge of the offer management process and ability to transfer execution knowledge to support tender teams in cost and time estimations and supplier selections Solid knowledge of EHS and Quality Management principles in site execution environments, with the ability to translate standards into daily practice. Proven ability to advise, coach, and influence site teams and contractors without direct line authority. Pragmatic, solution‑oriented mindset with the credibility to be accepted on site by supervisors, contractors, and project managers. Ability to identify risks early, communicate clearly, and escalate constructively where necessary. Experience working across Asia Pacific & China, with awareness of regional regulatory, cultural, and contractor‑market differences. Willingness to travel extensively across the region and work directly on active construction sites. Fluency in English; additional regional languages are an advantage. Positioning & Clarification This role does not carry end‑to‑end project responsibility and does not replace the Project Manager or Site Manager. The role operates as part of the regional Project Governance & PMO organization, under the Head of Project Governance & PMO. Success is measured by improved site execution quality, safer sites, stronger contractor performance, and reduced escalation of execution issues. About The Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Opportunities to work with a team spread across different locations Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects Remote/Flexible work Jobs & Careers: https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

review_candidates.title: QAQC CSA Supervisor
review_candidates.description: QA/QC CSA Supervisor About CTS Group CTS Group is a fast-growing international design and build company specializing in data center development across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). We combine engineering excellence, innovation, and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable, and future-ready data center solutions. With over 40 nationalities represented across our teams, CTS fosters a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture where innovation and technical precision drive every project. Beyond construction, CTS develops digital systems and standardized modular data center units to meet the evolving needs of hyperscalers, colocation providers, and enterprise clients. Our proven track record and strong partnerships have established CTS as a trusted industry leader delivering large-scale, complex data center facilities with speed, efficiency, and excellence. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced QA/QC CSA Supervisor to support the successful delivery of a large-scale data center project. Reporting to the QA/QC Manager, the successful candidate will oversee daily quality assurance and quality control activities related to Civil, Structural, and Architectural (CSA) works, ensuring all construction activities are performed in accordance with project specifications, approved procedures, and applicable standards. This hands-on site-based role requires strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively with construction teams, subcontractors, consultants, and client representatives to achieve the highest quality standards throughout project delivery. Key Responsibilities Site Quality Supervision Supervise day-to-day QA/QC activities for all Civil, Structural, and Architectural works on site. Coordinate inspections and testing activities with construction teams, subcontractors, consultants, and client representatives. Ensure works are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs). Monitor ongoing site activities to verify compliance with project quality requirements. Inspection & Testing Conduct and witness inspections for concrete works, structural steel, architectural finishes, waterproofing, façades, and other CSA-related activities. Verify that materials delivered to site meet approved submittals and project specifications. Coordinate testing activities and ensure results are properly documented and reviewed. Ensure hold points, witness points, and quality checkpoints are implemented and signed off as required. Quality Documentation & Reporting Maintain accurate inspection records, test reports, checklists, and quality documentation. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly QA/QC reports for project management. Track quality performance metrics and support progress reporting. Ensure quality documentation is maintained and compiled for project handover. Non-Conformance Management Identify quality issues, deficiencies, and non-conformances during construction activities. Raise and monitor NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Support root cause investigations and verification of close-out actions. Escalate significant quality risks to QA/QC management when required. Subcontractor Quality Management Monitor subcontractor quality performance and compliance with project requirements. Provide guidance and support to site teams regarding quality standards and inspection requirements. Participate in subcontractor audits, toolbox talks, and quality awareness initiatives. Promote a proactive quality culture across all CSA work packages. Coordination & Stakeholder Management Work closely with construction, engineering, HSE, commissioning, and project management teams. Attend quality meetings, coordination meetings, and client inspections. Support external audits conducted by clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Ensure effective communication and resolution of quality-related issues across project stakeholders. Essential Qualifications & Experience Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of QA/QC experience on large-scale construction projects, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Strong experience overseeing Civil, Structural, and Architectural works. Proven experience on data center, mission-critical, industrial, commercial, or infrastructure projects. Strong understanding of construction quality management systems and inspection processes. Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, method statements, and quality documentation. Experience managing inspections, testing activities, punch lists, and handover documentation. Preferred Data center or mission-critical project experience. Familiarity with international quality standards and codes including ISO 9001, ASTM, ACI, AISC, BS, and EN standards. Internal Auditor or Quality Management certification. Experience working for a main contractor in a fast-paced construction environment. Skills & Competencies Strong leadership and site supervision capabilities. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality standards. Effective communication and coordination skills. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Confident interacting with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and project teams. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QA/QC reporting systems. Strong organizational and documentation management skills. What We Offer Opportunity to work on high-profile, cutting-edge data center developments. Competitive salary and benefits package. Dynamic and collaborative project environment. Exposure to complex, mission-critical construction projects. Long-term project pipeline and career development opportunities within a growing international organization. The opportunity to contribute to the delivery of world-class digital infrastructure. Why Join CTS Group? At CTS Group, quality is fundamental to every project we deliver. As a QA/QC CSA Supervisor, you will play a key role in ensuring the successful delivery of mission-critical facilities that meet the highest international standards. Join a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement while helping shape the future of digital infrastructure across the EMEA region.
